title: test_growth_e31_validity header comment still says '10 windows' after the change to 20
evidence:
core/growth_test.odin:136: "// A long run (10 windows) with the full fixture + a player-placed router"
core/growth_test.odin:154: "	run_growth(&s, 20*GROWTH_INTERVAL_TICKS, cat)"
core/growth_test.odin:178: "	testing.expectf(t, spawned > 0, \"20 growth windows must spawn at least one terminal, got %d\", spawned)"
detail: The diff doubled the run to 20 windows but left the function's header comment claiming 10 — a reader auditing the E31 coverage window gets the wrong number.
recommended_fix: Update the comment at core/growth_test.odin:136 to 'A long run (20 windows)'.

title: PR body describes terminal_types.dem as 'fixture + one small_biz + one campus' but the demo is fixture off with 7 explicit spawns
evidence:
_bmad-output/pr-bodies/5.11.md: "New `demos/terminal_types.dem` (era 3, growth on, fixture + one small_biz + one campus): captures at 5000 ms and 30000 ms"
demos/terminal_types.dem: "fixture off" followed by "spawn_node router_mid 20 15 / spawn_node residential 8 15 / spawn_node content_host 32 15 / spawn_node residential 14 22 / spawn_node residential 26 22 / spawn_node small_biz 12 10 / spawn_node campus 30 10"
detail: The PR body's golden description misstates the demo's topology (implies the standard 3-node fixture; the demo actually defines its own 7-node map with three homes, a host, a small_biz and a campus around a mid router).
recommended_fix: Rephrase the PR body to 'fixture off + explicit spawns: 3 homes, a host, one small_biz, one campus around a mid router'.
